svg.text: On a block, you can be wrong on most markets and still finish in profit,

text.style: font-family:'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:500;fill:#424245;letter-spacing:-0.57px

svg.text: because each winning market pays more than each losing market costs.
